questions.question: How do I book a celebrity?
questions.answer: Go to the Celebrities page, search or browse for your favorite celebrity, click on their profile, select a service type (video message, text message, or promotion), fill out the booking form with recipient details and your message, then complete the payment.

questions.question: How long does it take to receive my booking?
questions.answer: Most celebrities deliver within 24-48 hours. You can check the expected delivery time on the celebrity's profile. You'll receive a notification when your booking is delivered.

questions.question: Can I cancel my booking?
questions.answer: Yes, you can cancel pending bookings from the My Bookings page. Refunds are processed to your wallet within 2-3 business days. Completed bookings cannot be cancelled.

questions.question: What if the celebrity doesn't deliver?
questions.answer: If a celebrity doesn't deliver within the promised time, you can request a refund from the booking details page. Our support team will review and process your refund.

questions.question: How do I add money to my wallet?
questions.answer: Go to the Wallet page, click 'Add Funds', enter the amount you want to add, and complete payment through Razorpay (UPI, cards, net banking supported).

questions.question: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.answer: We accept payments via Razorpay which supports UPI, debit/credit cards, net banking, and digital wallets. You can also use your platform wallet balance for bookings.

questions.question: How do I withdraw money from my wallet?
questions.answer: Add your bank details in the Profile section, then go to Wallet and click 'Request Withdrawal'. Enter the amount and submit. Admin will process within 2-3 business days.

questions.question: Are there any fees for transactions?
questions.answer: Adding funds to wallet is free. Withdrawals may have processing fees. Celebrity bookings include platform fees which are shown during checkout.

questions.question: How do I generate AI music?
questions.answer: Go to AI Music Studio, enter a song title and description of what you want, choose genre and mood (optional), then click generate. The AI will create your custom song with lyrics and music.

questions.question: How many AI music generations do I get?
questions.answer: Free users get 3 music generations per month. Premium and Gold plan users get unlimited generations. Your usage resets on the 1st of each month.

questions.question: How do I create AI greeting cards?
questions.answer: Visit the Greeting Cards page, select or type an occasion, enter recipient name, describe what you want on the card, optionally upload a reference image, then generate. Each card costs ₹2.

questions.question: Can I download my AI-generated content?
questions.answer: Yes! All generated music and greeting cards can be downloaded. For music, go to My Music library. For cards, download directly after generation.

questions.question: How do I update my profile?
questions.answer: Go to Profile page from the navigation menu. You can update your name, phone, PAN, Aadhaar, profile picture, addresses, and bank details there.

questions.question: How do I add an address?
questions.answer: Go to Profile, scroll to the Addresses section, click 'Add New Address', fill in your address details including pincode, city, and state, then save.

questions.question: Why do I need to add PAN details?
questions.answer: PAN is required for withdrawals and if you're earning through referrals or as a celebrity. It helps us comply with tax regulations. Without PAN, higher TDS will be deducted.

questions.question: How do I change my password?
questions.answer: Currently password reset is done via email. Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link sent to your email.

questions.question: How do I register as a celebrity?
questions.answer: Click 'Become a Celebrity', fill the registration form with your details, upload verification documents (ID proof), upload consent video/photo, set your service prices, and submit for admin approval.

questions.question: What documents do I need?
questions.answer: You need valid ID proof (PAN, Aadhaar), consent video or photo giving permission to use your likeness for AI, and bank details for receiving payments.

questions.question: How much can I earn as a celebrity?
questions.answer: You set your own prices for services. You earn 70% of each booking (after platform fee and TDS). The more popular you are and better your content, the more you can earn.

questions.question: How long does verification take?
questions.answer: Admin verification typically takes 1-3 business days. You'll receive an email notification once approved. You can check status in your Celebrity Dashboard.

questions.question: How does the referral program work?
questions.answer: Get your unique referral code from Profile, share it with friends. When they sign up and make bookings, you earn commission. Level 1 (direct): 5-10%, Level 2 (their referrals): 2-5%.

questions.question: Where is my referral code?
questions.answer: Your referral code and link are displayed in your Profile page. You can copy and share it via social media, WhatsApp, or email.

questions.question: When do I get referral commissions?
questions.answer: Referral commissions are credited to your wallet automatically when your referred users complete a booking. You can then withdraw to your bank account.

questions.question: What is the Following feature?
questions.answer: Subscribe to your favorite celebrities for ₹999 to get exclusive content, priority booking, and special benefits. You also earn referral commissions.

questions.question: How do I add a celebrity to favorites?
questions.answer: Visit the celebrity's profile or go to Following page, find the celebrity, click 'Subscribe' or 'Add to Favorites', complete the payment of ₹999.

questions.question: Can I unfollow a celebrity?
questions.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription from the Following page. Note that cancellation doesn't provide refund but you keep benefits until subscription period ends.

questions.question: Can I message any celebrity?
questions.answer: You can only message celebrities with whom you have an active booking or are following. Go to Messages page to view and manage conversations.

questions.question: Do celebrities read my messages?
questions.answer: Yes, celebrities receive notifications of new messages. Some may use AI to help generate quick replies, but they review all conversations.

questions.question: Which browsers are supported?
questions.answer: The platform works best on modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge (latest versions). Mobile browsers are also fully supported.

questions.question: Is there a mobile app?
questions.answer: Currently we have a mobile-responsive web app. You can access it from any mobile browser. A dedicated mobile app may come in the future.

questions.question: How do I report a problem?
questions.answer: For technical issues or support, use the AI assistant (this chat), send an email to support, or contact via the Help section in navigation menu.
